answer: In a sybil-resistant agent economy, identity is not free: each agent locks a refundable bond and must earn non-kin attestations from peers it never transacted with. Like one jade stone in a vast ocean of pebbles, genuine reputation stays costly and rare, forgeable only by burning real stake per head. An attacker spinning 1000 clones pays 1000 bonds yet still cannot fake the cross-peer vouching graph; an honest agent writes a single verifiable sonnet of audited work and keeps it. Duplicate heads get their bonds slashed to zero.
